polytrack.title: PolyTrack - Fast-Paced Low-Poly Driving Game
polytrack.slogan: Race, Build, Improve - Every Millisecond Counts!
polytrack.description: PolyTrack is a fast-paced, low-poly driving game featuring thrilling loops, jumps, and high-speed action. Inspired by TrackMania, it challenges you to race against the clock, constantly striving to improve your time on various tracks built by you and the PolyTrack community. Experience the adrenaline and play PolyTrack now!
